dct_description_sm:
This data set contains information on inspections carried out by the Health Division of the Real Estate Strategy and Housing Department (formerly the Housing Department).

The City of Montreal, through its [Regulation Respecting Health, Maintenance and Security of Housing (R.V.M. 03-096)] (https://montreal.ca/reglements-municipaux/recherche/60d7656afd6531443f578d96), ensures the health, good maintenance and security of housing and residential buildings on its territory. 

Health refers to all the conditions that make a home suitable for housing.

For more information on the efforts made by the City of Montreal in terms of housing health, consult the [Housing Health, Maintenance and Security web page] (https://montreal.ca/sujets/salubrite-entretien-et-securite-des-logements).

**Note: ** This package only concerns inspections carried out by the Health Division of the Real Estate Strategy and Housing Department, and not those carried out by borough staff. 

The inspection data does not present a portrait of unsanitary conditions or a diagnosis of the condition of the rental housing stock, but rather the work done by the team.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
